fact: The BCEAO governor launched the interoperable instant payment platform PI-SPI on 30 September 2025, linking banks, e-money issuers, microfinance institutions and payment institutions across the UEMOA.

leFaso.net reports that the BCEAO, which sets the connection deadlines for banks, e-money and payment institutions and microfinance, launched the PI-SPI interoperable instant payment platform on 30 September 2025, with 80 institutions connected by 24 June 2026.
leFaso.net reports that PI-SPI is a BCEAO instant payment platform across the UEMOA, in service since 30 September 2025.

As of 24 February 2026 the BCEAO had authorised nine institutions in Burkina Faso (including Orange Money, Coris Bank International and Ecobank) to offer PI-SPI instant payment services to the public.
